conflicts.fact: Angle of depression from the top of the mast is claimed to be 40°, complementary to the 50° elevation, but Lesson 7 teaches that elevation from A equals depression from B (alternate angles), so the depression at the top would be 50°, not 40°.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 labels a 40° angle of depression at the top of the mast (with the 50° elevation at the base) and says the engineer can use either angle. Lesson 7 states the angle of elevation from A to B equals the angle of depression from B to A, which gives 50°.

conflicts.fact: Mombasa dhow distance from the Fort Jesus cliff differs within the same lesson.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7 Observed says the teacher-modelled depression problem gives a dhow distance of about 28.6 m; Lesson 7 Explained says the Mombasa dhow distance is about 31.1 m.

conflicts.fact: Lake Victoria lighthouse problem has different angles in the overview and in the Explain phase.
conflicts.versions: Overview says the boat is seen at a depression of 32° and the lighthouse at an elevation of 25°, from a fisherman on a cliff. Explain phase says the boat is 120 m from the cliff base, the elevation is 38° and the depression is 22°, observed by a coastguard on top of the lighthouse.

conflicts.fact: Mast height value and tan 50° precision: Lesson 4 Predict uses sin 50°=0.766 and cos 50°=0.643, giving tan≈1.191; Lesson 6 uses tan 50°≈1.1918, while Lesson 2 uses 1.192. All are consistent with 47.7 m, so this is a rounding-only difference.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2: tan 50° ≈ 1.192; Lesson 6: 1.1918; Lesson 4: ratio of 0.766/0.643.

conflicts.fact: Lesson 4 says the cos 90° = 0 question will be met in Lesson 5, and tan 90° undefined is indeed in Lesson 5; but Lesson 4 also says going backwards would be in Lessons 5 and 6, while Lesson 5 does not cover it.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 flags the backwards (given tan, find sin and cos) questions as 'coming in Lesson 5 and Lesson 6'; Lesson 5 covers only special angles, and Lesson 6 covers inverse tangent for angles only.

conflicts.fact: Source of the data table used in Lesson 4 differs from what Lesson 2 produced.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 says learners retrieve Lesson 2 tables listing sin, cos and tan for 20°, 30°, 40°, 50°, 60°, 70° at which a fourth column is added. Lesson 2 has learners measure triangles of about 35° and 60° and look up table values only for their measured angles.

conflicts.fact: Lesson 5 says the 0° and 90° limit evidence comes from the trig tables in Lesson 3, but Lesson 3's six angle pairs (15°–75°) include no values near 0° or 90°.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 uses Lesson 3 trig table columns as evidence for 0° and 90° behaviour; Lesson 3 table covers only 15°, 20°, 25°, 30°, 35°, 42°, 48°, 55°, 60°, 65°, 70°, 75°.
